entities.name: Pedro de Sousa Holstein, 1st Duke of Palmela
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dom Pedro de Sousa Holstein, 1st Duke of Faial and Palmela was one of the most important Portuguese diplomats and statesmen in the first half of the 19th century. He also served as the country's first modern Prime Minister.
